notes:
Account focused on GitHub-style PR assistant product: inline diff summaries, automated review comments, and ranking candidate comments. Key ask: sub-200ms token latency for streaming completions inside IDE/PR UI. Team heavy on TypeScript + Rust backend; wants model pinning per repo and deterministic outputs for policy checks.

Key quotes from demo: 'We need consistent diffs across dev machines — nondeterministic assistants are regressions.' — lead PM.

Cost sensitivity: mid; willing to pay for predictable per-commit throughput. Interested in batching suggestions across file-changes but must maintain interactive feel. Concerned about eval drift when model rollout occurs.

Prefer hosted initially for speed of integration (webhooks + SSE), but want path to Dedicated (single-tenant GPU pools) for low jitter. Also asked about offline air-gapped option for regulated customers (future).

use_case_summary: ReviewCraft builds an IDE-embedded PR reviewer that summarizes diffs, suggests comments, and ranks comment candidates. Primary constraints: interactive streaming from model during review, model/version pinning per repository and per-branch, reproducible outputs for CI gating, and reranking layer to prefer security-friendly suggestions. Must integrate with GitHub webhooks and block merge on policy regressions.
